nodes.text: The trees and branches whip by as Sam flies through the forest, laughing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm the fastest ninja! I'm the fastest ninja!
Before long, she finds herself at the base of the big tree, staring at the black flag.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! I won!
Sam's victory declaration is cut short though. All around the tree is a thick pool of muddy water.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh.
She can hear the rest of the boys trampling through the forest behind her... And she doesn't hesitate.
Her shoes sink in and soon she's up to her shins in mud...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Mom is going to kill me...
But a few seconds later, she pulls the black flag down from the tree!
The boys arrive... Astonished.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Whoa! Sam's the ultimate ninja! How'd you get here so fast?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ninjas don't tell secrets...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on, Amanda. Let's check out the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Bye, Mr. Mittens!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Mittens
nodes.text: Mrow!
Hector drags Amanda into the next room, where a DJ is spinning an incredible beat in front of a huge crowd!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: That's... That's... That's...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You sound just like the song!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda, that's...

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: `...DJ JD!` He's a friend of mine! Thanks for coming to my party!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]...DJ JD![/i][/color] He's a friend of mine! Thanks for coming to my party!

nodes.text: James moves past Hector, shaking hands with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This is `your` party?!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] party?!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: You having a good time?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Good time?! I had one two rooms ago!

nodes.speaker: James
nodes.text: Amanda, right? Want to dance?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Of course!
James leads Amanda out onto the dance floor. Hector stands there, dumbfounded.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: If I'm no longer the party guy... Then what am I to Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Just some chump?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Uh...
Bryce stares at his camera...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: No! I was going to say she could be a...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: ...A person who gets paid to have her picture taken!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That sounds fun too! I want to do that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Listen, bro. I `invented` the 'you're so hot you could be a model' line...
nodes.text_bbcode: Listen, bro. I [color=#e23b3b][i]invented[/i][/color] the 'you're so hot you could be a model' line...

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's weak. It's used. Get outta here.
Bryce turns to leave...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh... And calling my girlfriend my sister... That's low, man, real low.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I... I know... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Are you stupid or something?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What? That isn't what you were going to say?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I was going to say she could be a model.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! That's true! I could!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Why don't you come with me, and we'll take some photos?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!
Bryce starts to lead Amanda away!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `So` embarrassing!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]So[/i][/color] embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Amanda! What about Mr. Mittens?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! How could I forget him?!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: Mr. Mittens?
Amanda turns, immediately erasing Bryce from her memory. Bryce shakes his head, muttering to himself as he leaves.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A, um...

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: A what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: A politician?
Hector takes her hand.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Come on. Time to check out the rest of this party...
Hector leads Amanda into the next room, which is filled with...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Kitties! Eeeeeeep! They're all so furry!
Amanda skips across the room, giggling as she plays with a bunch of kittens!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You're Mr. Mittens, and you're Mr. Fuzzles, and you're Porkchop!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Mittens
nodes.text: Mrow! Mrow! Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No way! One hundred percent party satisfaction `and` animals to play with!
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! One hundred percent party satisfaction [color=#e23b3b][i]and[/i][/color] animals to play with!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Mr. Mittens is my new best friend!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, whoever threw this party at least dropped the ball a little. I mean, how can you have cats but no--?
Hector is interrupted by a hot, breathy feeling on his leg. He looks down into the soft eyes of a fuzzy-haired puppy!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That's Mr. Moustache!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Moustache
nodes.text: Woof! Woof! Woof!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well-played, mystery host, well-played.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: My smile hurts!

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: You're telling me.
Bryce approaches Amanda, wearing a M.A.N. shirt and holding a fancy-looking camera.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: A smile as perfect as yours deserves to be seen by everyone!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, hey! That was a nice thing to say! Did you hear what this guy said to me, Hecky?
Hector quickly rushes over!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah. I did.

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: I was just telling your sister here that she might have a career as a--

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: --Really? You're using this tired line?

nodes.speaker: Bryce
nodes.text: It's not a line! I was just going to tell her she could be a--

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: She could be a what?
Dontae hangs his head.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Yes...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh. So, you're not the super rich guy you're posing as in order to woo my girlfriend?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: No...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Free tips... Go away. Find some game. And don't bother any other girls until you actually have some.

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Okay...
Dontae shuffles off...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Awww! I bet his car was shiny!

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Heh. You don't know anything about cars, do you?
Hector tries to look tough for a second, but he can't hold it.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No, no I do not...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Why don't you wait here while I drive this fine girl around the block a few times?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hee hee! I heard that!
Dontae takes Amanda's hand and leads her toward the front door...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey! Amanda! What are you doing?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I just want to see his car! I bet it's shiny!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Think fast, Hector!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, that guy `hates` marshmallows!
nodes.text_bbcode: Manda-Panda, that guy [color=#e23b3b][i]hates[/i][/color] marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What?! I can't be seen with you then!
Amanda lets go of Dontae's hand and returns to Hector.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So embarrassing. I have to trick my girlfriend into staying with me...
You are now playing as Hector...
Night falls on the M.A.N. fraternity party...
Hector follows Amanda through a large house packed with college students! His jaw dangles open from shock.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, we are not at Twin Branches anymore...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Even `I` knew that!
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] knew that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: This party is... Is... A masterpiece!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Forget about `fifty` people... There must be hundreds!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forget about [color=#e23b3b][i]fifty[/i][/color] people... There must be hundreds!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `N's` even!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]N's[/i][/color] even!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: And all the people... They're `all` dancing! All laughing! One hundred percent party satisfaction!
nodes.text_bbcode: And all the people... They're [color=#e23b3b][i]all[/i][/color] dancing! All laughing! One hundred percent party satisfaction!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I've only dreamed of parties where `everyone` was having a good time!
nodes.text_bbcode: I've only dreamed of parties where [color=#e23b3b][i]everyone[/i][/color] was having a good time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I want to have a good time!
Amanda's comment gets the attention of a nearby college guy...

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Oh yeah? If you want to have a good time, why don't you come with me for a ride in my brand-new sports car?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! That sounds like fun!
Hector steps in between them!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: New car, huh?

nodes.speaker: Dontae
nodes.text: Uh, yeah. Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Never mind that, bro. Let's talk about that car...

options.label: Did Mommy and Daddy buy that for you?
Does it have fully automatic camshafts?

nodes.text: Sam tries to catch up to the guys, but she stumbles her way through the forest!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to make it!
Exhausted, she finds herself in a clearing, facing a big tree.
She runs toward it, but trips over a log and goes sprawling face first into a pool of mud!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Aww, man! Mom is gonna kill me!
When she crawls out, she sees her friend standing there, holding the black flag.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: I'm the ultimate ninja!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This isn't over! I demand a rematch!

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Ninjas don't rematch!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever...
You are now playing as Sam...
Later that day...
Sam is watching a zombie movie in the living room while $ZOE sets up arrangements for a tea party outside...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is going to be great! I've got tiny sandwiches, scones, and `seven` different kinds of tea!
nodes.text_bbcode: This is going to be great! I've got tiny sandwiches, scones, and [color=#3b78e2][i]seven[/i][/color] different kinds of tea!

nodes.text: $ZOE calls to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're sure you're okay with this, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yes, yes, yes! For the thousandth time, yes! I'm okay with us having our annual tea party. Satisfied?
$ZOE mutters to herself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, you don't have to say it like that...
She tries to forget about it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, how would you feel about a jasmine chamomile blend?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't know. To be honest, I couldn't care less.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it!
$ZOE marches into the living room, grabs the remote from Sam, and turns the TV off!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey! I was watching that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Exactly! You `were` watching that! Now you're watching me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! You [color=#3b78e2][i]were[/i][/color] watching that! Now you're watching me!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The horde is about to strike! Turn it back on!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I won't! Not until I get some answers!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How about you being a jerk to me every time I bring up this tea party?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You were rude to me at lunch, and you were rude to me just now.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't want to say anything, but it happens every year! What gives?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really want to know?! You really want to know why I can't stand your annual tea party?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! I'm standing here asking about it, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine! I'll tell you!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You probably don't even remember what happened that day, do you?!
Eight years ago...
Sam bounds out of the house, excited to play!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha! Make sure you're back by six! Your cousin's going to be here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay, I'll try, Mom! Bye!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Samantha!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: This isn't a 'try' situation. Your cousin... Will need you, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Okay. Geez. I'll be back at six!
Sam dashes off before her mother can add anything more.
Not long after, Sam runs into a bunch of friendly neighborhood boys in the woods behind her house.

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Hey, Sam! Wanna play with us?!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure! What are you playing?

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Ninja Racing Ultra!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, how do you play that?

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: It's really easy! Just run to the big tree in the woods and get the black flag! Whoever gets it, wins!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm in!
Sam and the boys line up at the edge of the woods...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When do we--

nodes.speaker: Boy
nodes.text: Three two one go!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey!
The boys takes off running! Sam follows, sprinting as fast as her little legs can run!

nodes.prompt: Run as fast as you can!
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.text: Colt lets go of Keith.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah. Uh, you're free to go, Keith.
Keith dusts himself off.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Happy graduation. I can't say that I'll miss you.
Keith limps off.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Did we learn a lesson just now?
Denni is expecting an aggressive, snarky comeback from Colt, but instead he turns from her, glaring out the window.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Can we skip the fun, rub-it-in part and go straight to questioning the rest of the cheerleaders?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sure. Whatever you want...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I think all the cheerleaders are in Mr. Russell's class right now.
A moment later, in Mr. Russell's class...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Great! There's no one here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm here! Perfect attendance once again!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut up, Glasses.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, sir!
Back in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I guess ditch day is more of a thing than I realized...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What are we going to do?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Relax, Super Nerd. We'll still have time at graduation to question the cheerleaders before $ZOE's speech.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah... But that's going to cut it real close...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: We've had girls at this school steal tiaras and... And... And other stuff I'm sure!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds a lot like an exception to the rule!
Colt pulls Keith away from the locker, preparing to slam him into it...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Wait! He didn't do it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do you know?!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: He's like the only cheerleader `not` in Ms. Prez's class.
nodes.text_bbcode: He's like the only cheerleader [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] in Ms. Prez's class.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, then why'd you run?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I don't know... Maybe because a maniac was charging at me!
Colt pulls Keith away from the locker, preparing to slam him into it... When Denni's words sink in.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: They don't?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: No... It's kind of a girly thing, you know. Like driving a pink car.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: That true, Gel... Guy?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Gel Guy?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Look, not all the nicknames are gold, okay? Just answer the question!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What... Do I use pom-poms? No!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: If you didn't do anything wrong, then why'd you run?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Because a maniac was charging at me!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I `am` thinking about it, Princess!
Denni blurts out the first thing that comes to her mind!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Girls commit crimes too!
A few minutes later, Colt, Denni, and Kevin are investigating Kevin's desk area...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'd been keeping the drive in my pocket, but I didn't feel like that was secure so when I went to the bathroom before class, I moved the drive to my backpack...

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Then in class, I went up to the front to talk to Ms. Prez...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: And when you got back the drive was gone?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Yeah... Who would do something like this?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: A cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: What? That's oddly specific.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Check it out.
Colt holds up a glittery piece of pom-pom.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Keith did this! That son of a--
Colt bolts out of the classroom and into the hall!
Denni chases after him, Kevin on her heels.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Hey, Captain Conclusion Jumper, how'd you get 'Keith' from a piece of pom-pom?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Easy, Princess. If there's anything I've learned preparing for police academy, it's that guys commit crimes.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That's... Weirdly sexist.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Call it whatever you want, there are nine times as many dudes in prison as there are chicks!
Colt scans the halls, looking for Keith.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Ladies and gentleman, statistics for idiots.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And we know Hector didn't do this. He's a good dude!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: But Keith isn't? Look, Colt, this is a bad idea.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You were right there when all the female cheerleaders were insulting $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And you're going to be right there when I catch that gel-wearing perp!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You're not thinking straight! You need to calm down!
They round the corner... And see Keith at a locker!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You!
Colt charges Keith! Keith tries to escape, but Colt tackles him, and they both go sprawling to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why'd you do it?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Do what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why'd you steal $ZOE's speech?!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: What the flaming crap are you talking about?!
Colt hoists Keith to his feet, pushing him up against a locker!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Don't make me play the bad cop!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt, you're making a mistake! Think about it...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Really? Didn't expect to hear that from you, Professor Board of Education.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, well, the experience of taking on a real case could be `huge!` And we can always get the signatures after...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, well, the experience of taking on a real case could be [color=#3b78e2][i]huge![/i][/color] And we can always get the signatures after...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Besides, if you're on this case, you're out of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trouble? When have I ever gotten into trouble?!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: When haven't you? Our first kiss happened after escaping a high security prison!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, but when else?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Two words. Exploding. Helicopter.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oooh! I heard all about that! Hee!
Colt gives Kimi a puzzled look. Then looks back at Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay... You got me, Princess. Good looking out.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's what I do.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I'm glad you sorted that out, but... The flash drive?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Chill, Super Nerd, and show us the crime scene.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Could you say that again? Because it sounded like you said something was `more important` than making out!
nodes.text_bbcode: Could you say that again? Because it sounded like you said something was [color=#e23b3b][i]more important[/i][/color] than making out!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Oh, would you grow up?! Kevin and Kimi need our help!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, I got that. But I'm trying to figure out how doing something helpful suddenly means no trips to Make Out City for me.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I misspoke, okay?! Just help them! Otherwise, there won't be any Make Out City... `Ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I misspoke, okay?! Just help them! Otherwise, there won't be any Make Out City... [color=#3b78e2][i]Ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Careful, Princess. You don't want to make threats you can't keep.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Who says I can't?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: These lips!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry to interrupt, but we're kind of running out of time and, you know, this fight or whatever doesn't seem like it's going to end anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. Cold Fish over here's just making me grumpy. Show me the crime scene.

nodes.title: Colt and Denni, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: The Case of the Stolen Speech

nodes.text: You are now playing as Denni...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey! Wait up, Princess!
Colt catches up to Denni.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Were you serious about making out tonight?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yup! And all you have to do is come with me to visit all our teachers.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sounds fishy.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Crazy as this seems, I might actually care about you graduating and qualifying for police academy.
Just then, Kimi and Kevin come running up!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Colt! Denni! Just the people we were looking for!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Whatever you're about to say, save it! I've got a make out session riding on me getting signatures now!
Colt starts to head off, but Denni holds him by the arm.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: I like that attitude! But what's up, guys?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: First off, can I just say...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You two are, like, super adorbz! You're almost like Powen before Powen! You're Dolt!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... Never mind!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Was any of that English?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Forget about that! The flash drive with $ZOE's speech on it... Someone stole it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: How do you know you didn't just lose it?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Because I don't lose things. I'm highly organized. I even alphabetize my collectible card collection. And--

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Okay, okay, Super Nerd. It was stolen. I believe you. Just don't bore me into a coma.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Colt! Be nice!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Sorry. You're not a super nerd. You're just an average nerd.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Sigh. I'll take it.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It would mean a lot if you would help us get the flash drive back without $ZOE ever knowing. She's stressed out enough as it is!

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: Not to mention what she'd do to me if she found out...

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Wow. You're scared of $ZOE? I didn't know that was possible.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Aww! I think it's cute!
Kevin blushes.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: So, 'Super Nerd' is looking more accurate now, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: I don't care what kind of nerd you think I am. Will you help us?

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: You're the closest thing we have to a real detective.
Colt gives Denni an intense look.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I know you wanted those signatures, but come on, Tiny Hipster...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This is my chance to be a cop! To help a dweeb in need!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, you may be uncouth, but your general instincts are actually right for once.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: For always.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Besides, doing this right now is way more important than...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't know why Maria's bothering you, anyway...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a power thing. The Head Cheerleader needs to establish herself as dominant and aggressive.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, she gets power for, like, a day, and then she graduates?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, no, she's not graduating.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's not?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nicole is though, right?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Guess again.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wait... All of you are graduating... Aren't you?
Everyone at the table nods their head.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Taylor too?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No. Try again, dawg!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Come on. Brendan `has` to be graduating.
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on. Brendan [color=#e23b3b][i]has[/i][/color] to be graduating.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Listen, New Guy. I've been here a while now, and every year I get all confused about who's a senior, who's a junior, who's whatever.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Believe me, it'll make life a lot easier if you just let it go.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just let it go?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I already forgot!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Never thought I'd say this, but Red's got the right idea.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks, Pony!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Anyway, my boyfriend's genius advice notwithstanding, we've still got to go get signatures from our teachers excusing our absences.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Turns out, you can't stop going to school and still graduate.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Could you be any lamer? It's the `last` day. This day was meant for ditching!
nodes.text_bbcode: Could you be any lamer? It's the [color=#e23b3b][i]last[/i][/color] day. This day was meant for ditching!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Really? You want to ditch getting signatures that enable us to graduate?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, `both` of us don't have to be there, do we?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] of us don't have to be there, do we?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: That depends... Do both of us have to be there for us to make out tonight?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She always plays that card. I hate that card.
Denni heads out of the cafeteria, and Colt lumbers off behind her...
The cheerleaders are stunned... But only for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Look who it is, $ZOE's protector!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: 'Oh, Owen, the mean girls are picking on me. Please come to my rescue!'

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Are you ever going to fight your own fights, Little Miss Nauseating?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, I know you were trying to help. But I really wish you hadn't said that...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Me too...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just ignore them. They'll get bored.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `And` you didn't even do anything to win Social Chair!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] you didn't even do anything to win Social Chair!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: 'Look at me, I'm $ZOE! I need help with everything I do!'

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Pathetic.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm sorry, $ZOE. When will they get bored?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Soon...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You, um, have a weird name! $ZOE?! Who names their kid $ZOE?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: 'I love Howard! Now I love Owen! Now I love Howard!'

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Pfft! Waffle much?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Wow. Now I'm `really` sorry...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. Now I'm [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] sorry...

nodes.text: After a minute or so, the cheerleaders finally move on...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You `actually` think that obvious distraction ploy is going to work on us?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] think that obvious distraction ploy is going to work on us?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Just because we're cheerleaders doesn't mean we're obsessed with fashion!

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Besides, we're all going to be wearing summer dresses with the school colors on them.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We are?

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: We aren't?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I `told` you I was wearing a mini-skirt, Lindsay!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]told[/i][/color] you I was wearing a mini-skirt, Lindsay!

nodes.text: The girls bicker, completely forgetting about $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't believe that worked. Thanks, Owen.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Add 'distracting cheerleaders' to my resume!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee! 'Cause that's not creepy or anything!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Awww. I wish I could go.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: For the nth time, Amanda, we're `both` going!
nodes.text_bbcode: For the nth time, Amanda, we're [color=#e23b3b][i]both[/i][/color] going!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Yay!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But wait... When did N become a number?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What makes this party so special?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Centerscore U's biggest fraternity, M.A.N., is throwing it! `And` Centerscore U's biggest sorority, O.M.G., is going to be there!
nodes.text_bbcode: Centerscore U's biggest fraternity, M.A.N., is throwing it! [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] Centerscore U's biggest sorority, O.M.G., is going to be there!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's going to have everything! Live music! At least fifty people! Plus you know there'll be something crazy, like a fog machine!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or marshmallows!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: For the first time ever, I'll be among my party equals.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: How do you even have time for partying?
Denni and Colt arrive, both of them looking exhausted.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, it helps not to have a busy internship.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Amen to that.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Tough times out in the real world?

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: Uh... Something like that.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Trust me, you don't want to know.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm just glad me and Tiny Hipster here get a break from all the serious crap we've been dealing with.

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: It's nice to be, you know, normal again... And I'd be cool seeing zero spiders for the rest of my life.
$ZOE's about to ask Denni for details when she sees the cheerleaders approaching.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Great...
They spot $ZOE at the table and deliberately sit as far away from her as possible. Owen notices all the cheerleaders are glaring daggers at her.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What's this about?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor and I were working out the graduation schedule, and we had to bump their cheer routine at the end because the ceremony was going to go too long... They weren't happy.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So why are they bothering you about it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, they're not going to go after Taylor. And even though I'm off the team, they're still upset about me missing so many practices. I really let them down.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE, heard you're not even writing your speech yourself!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She's so busy being Social Chair... You can't expect her to have time to do things the Social Chair's actually supposed to do!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: You can tell she doesn't care about this school because she put the speech in the hands of a nerd.

nodes.speaker: Lindsay
nodes.text: Not even... She put it in his lame, geeky comic-book backpack!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, girls...

options.label: What are you wearing to graduation?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, we were just talking about this tea party that $ZOE and--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really?! You too, Owen?! Did you `not` just hear me say I didn't want to talk about the dumb tea party?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Really?! You too, Owen?! Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just hear me say I didn't want to talk about the dumb tea party?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I... I didn't know that applied to me too.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, it does!
Sam's anger sentences the group to silence. After a long moment of awkwardness...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Soooooo... Who wants to talk about a less controversial party?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sounds like everyone does! Great! Because I'm going to `the` party of my life tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like everyone does! Great! Because I'm going to [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] party of my life tonight!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, well... I was about to sign $ZOE's yearbook, but I couldn't think of what to write.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'll be honest... I wasn't listening to a word you said. 'Cause I'm going to `the` hottest party in Centerscore tonight!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be honest... I wasn't listening to a word you said. 'Cause I'm going to [color=#e23b3b][i]the[/i][/color] hottest party in Centerscore tonight!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess being ignored is better than having Sam flip out over tea parties!
Owen sees a yearbook under $ZOE's tray.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Can I sign your yearbook?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Oh... Yeah, of course!
$ZOE hands him her yearbook and a pen. He opens it up, thinks about his year with $ZOE, and is quickly overwhelmed...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I'm not sure what to write...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, if all you put is, 'Have a good summer!' I'll be really disappointed.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Actually... Can I think about this a little more? I want it to say something memorable.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure! But you should know, expectations are now at an all-time high!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Noted.
Owen hands $ZOE's yearbook back to her as Sam plops down next to them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam! There you are! This is great. I need to calm down. If anything can distract me, it's the thought of the two of us, and our annual tea party tonight!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please please `please` let today end right now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Please please [color=#3b78e2][i]please[/i][/color] let today end right now...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, come on! You know you have fun playing with all the tiny teacups!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Big plans?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The biggest! It all started a long time ago, when Sam and I were really little--

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: --Do we have to go into this `now?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: --Do we have to go into this [color=#3b78e2][i]now?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm sorry, Sam...
Owen and $ZOE fall silent for a moment, but the silence is broken by the arrival of Hector and Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What's uuuuuuuuuuuuuup, my fellow graduates?! And Owen!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: And me too!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you think I wouldn't include the prettiest graduate of them all?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! That sounds like a mildly interesting fairy tale!
Hector turns to the others.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, what'd I miss?
$ZOE's eyes go wide!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't even consider that! I thought I might forget how to `read,` but...
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't even consider that! I thought I might forget how to [color=#3b78e2][i]read,[/i][/color] but...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But if that happened, I figured I could always wing it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But if I... If I get up there, and I can't speak! Ohmygosh!
$ZOE's breathing quickens!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I might have said the wrong thing...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just... Please... Don't try to help me anymore, okay?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sure...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You're $ZOE. That means you work hard for whatever it is you want, and because you work hard, you usually get it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww. Thanks, Owen. I think I just needed someone to listen to me for a second.

nodes.text: That's what my ears are for, right?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not going to what?

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.text: Crap!

$ZOE nervously steps up to the podium to give her graduation speech.
The flash drive is plugged into her laptop. Her speech is open. She begins...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My fellow graduating Twin Branches Squirrels... And former Centerscore Lizards...
As the crowd chuckles, the program causes the words of $ZOE's speech to scroll up like a teleprompter.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awesome! Thank you, Kevin!
Filled with newfound confidence, she continues, looking out into the crowd...
At Colt and Denni...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some of you have already moved on, beginning what I confidently believe will be promising careers!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To you, I say that from what I've seen, you are `more` than qualified!
nodes.text_bbcode: To you, I say that from what I've seen, you are [color=#3b78e2][i]more[/i][/color] than qualified!

nodes.text: The crowd cheers!
She looks at Hector and Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Some of you have been a part of beautiful relationships...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Tried, tested, unbroken... You've come out of this school with something that will `actually` last.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tried, tested, unbroken... You've come out of this school with something that will [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] last.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We all wish we could be so lucky.
The crowd nods in agreement.
She looks at Sam...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And some of you have had the strength and the will, the heart and the passion, to earn your way to college.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whether that college be Centerscore U. or Kingston University or, well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sometimes it seems like those are the only two colleges there are!
The crowd laughs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whatever your prospects... Whether a career, a relationship, a university... Or some other grand adventure...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Be proud! I could not be more proud of you!
The crowd begins clapping and hollering, anticipating the end of $ZOE's speech!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One last thing before we toss our mortarboards into the air...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Not everyone makes it. Not everyone is fortunate enough or hardworking enough or dedicated enough to do what we are doing right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My fellow classmates, we're not just graduates... We are `survivors!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My fellow classmates, we're not just graduates... We are [color=#3b78e2][i]survivors![/i][/color]

nodes.text: With that, the crowd explodes with applause, and the graduates toss their caps into the air!

nodes.text: Can I ask you something?

nodes.text: Why do you keep throwing tea parties?! I mean, wouldn't you want to forget that day?

nodes.text: Well... If we didn't do this, every year I'd just end up thinking about that day...

nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine!

nodes.text: Sam, I--

nodes.text: $ZOE wipes at her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I... I don't know what to say. I had no idea that you heard all that, $ZOE. And... And I never put it together about... About your parents.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's stupid.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No... It's not. I said some really mean things.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry.
Sam comes over and gives $ZOE a big hug!

nodes.text: Me too.

nodes.text: Can I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why do you keep throwing tea parties?! I mean, wouldn't you want to forget that day?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... That's why I throw them, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... If we didn't do this, every year I'd just end up thinking about that day...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But this way, I think about all the fun we've had year after year after year!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: You really think you can handle Ninja Racing Ultra?

You know what you have to do...
Hector hands Amanda the 90's Jamz record. When she has DJ JD's attention, she gives it to him.
I borrowed this! I love strawberry jam the most!
Hector hands Amanda the headphones. When she has DJ JD's attention, she gives them to him.
I borrowed these to make my boyfriend happy! Thanks!
Come on, Manda-Panda, let's get our groove on!
While the two of them dance, Sam comes up to $ZOE at a nearby table, holding two steaming mugs.
You didn't think I'd forget, did you?
Just don't ever do that bear voice again.
Nearby, Denni gets up on her tiptoes and whispers something in Colt's ear.
Yes! That is my favorite city!
Announce it to the world, why don't you?
Colt stops in the middle of the crowd of party-goers and yells at the top of his voice!
Listen up, everybody! Denni and I are about to take a one-way trip to MAKE OUT CITY!
The crowd cheers! Denni blushes as Colt leads her somewhere private...
Owen sits down next to $ZOE and Sam...
Hey, did you think of something to write in my yearbook?
Not going to let me off the hook, are you?
I did, actually. But then I realized that I'd rather just tell you what I was going to write. Can we go outside for a second?
Owen and $ZOE step outside, away from the music...
You've been there for me from day one, `literally.`
If it weren't for you, I don't know where I'd be... But I know I would not be nearly as happy as I am now.
I know that for a while there our feelings got all twisted up...
But you've become something I never thought I'd treasure as much as I do right now...
You've become a `friend,` $ZOE. And I just want you to know that...
$ZOE doesn't even try to hold back tears, as Owen pulls her in for a tight hug.
I'm going to miss you too.
After a long while, Owen lets her go...
I've... I've got to go home and check in on my Grandma...
Owen starts to walk away... But before he reaches the front gate, he turns...
Oh, one more thing... I did write something in your yearbook when you weren't looking...
Wiping the tears from her eyes, $ZOE opens her yearbook to the back page...
